name: Rosebud
one_liner: Rosebud is an AI journaling app: you write or speak about your day and it asks follow-up questions and shows patterns in your mood over time.
best_for: People who want prompts and follow-up questions while journaling
Spotting patterns in mood, stress and goals over weeks
Reflecting between therapy or coaching sessions
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988
People who do not want personal writing processed by an AI service
Anyone looking for a free journal (the free plan ended on September 30, 2026)
short_description: AI journaling app that responds to your writing or voice with follow-up questions and weekly summaries of mood and themes. Paid plan required.
long_description: Rosebud, from Just Imagine, Inc., is a journaling app on iPhone, Android and the web that uses AI language models to respond to what you write or say. It offers guided journals such as CBT-style and gratitude prompts, tracks mood and goals, and gives weekly summaries of themes. Rosebud ended its free plan on September 30, 2026; existing entries stay in your account and can be exported, but continuing to journal requires the Bloom plan, and heavier-use 'Thrive' tiers are sold in the mobile apps. We found no published study of Rosebud itself. It is a self-reflection tool, not therapy.
patient_summary: You write or talk about your day, and Rosebud replies with questions and suggestions, then summarizes patterns in your mood and goals each week. Since October 2026 you need the Bloom subscription to keep journaling; old entries can still be exported. It is not a substitute for professional care.

pricing.notes: Free plan retired September 30, 2026; existing entries remain exportable. Higher-usage Thrive tiers (reported from $24.99) are sold in the mobile apps. 40% off Bloom for students, people 65+ and people with a documented disability on web subscriptions (as reported). Trial length not confirmed on Rosebud's own pages.

privacy.notes: Uses Meta, Google and Apple advertising pixels to measure ads (says journal entries are not sent to them); describes 'HIPAA-aligned' handling with vendor BAAs but does not say it is HIPAA-covered; deletion by emailing support with 'Delete My Data'.

seo.title: Rosebud: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: Rosebud is an AI journaling app that asks follow-up questions as you write or speak, and summarises themes and mood patterns over time.

faqs.a: Free; Bloom $12.99/month or $107.99/year. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with Rosebud before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can Rosebud replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. Rosebud is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.
Rosebud is available on iPhone, Android and the web.
Text or voice journaling with AI prompts; CBT and gratitude journals; Mood and goal tracking; Weekly insights; Passcode / Face ID lock.

primary_uses: Text or voice journaling with AI follow-up questions

availability.note: Paid plan required since the free plan ended on September 30, 2026.
